value.rationale: An explicit counterexample to a precise, repeatedly published boundary-to-interior zero question is a motivated mathematical result, not an arbitrary zero computation. It demonstrates the structural effect of allowing a boundary weight to factor through a holomorphic function with a single interior zero: a rank-one Hardy compression can introduce a zero reaching a boundary argument. Both the weight and the witness interval are concrete, and proof margins are exact.
